itens.trecho: "Velozes e Furiosos 7" é, ao mesmo tempo, um blockbuster exagerado e uma despedida surpreendentemente sincera: enquanto abraça sem pudor o absurdo de sua própria escala, carros voando entre prédios, ação hiperbólica e um senso de espetáculo quase cartunesco, o filme encontra sua verdadeira força no elo emocional entre os personagens, especialmente na forma…

This is one of those movies where the French decided on an English name but for some inexplicable reason the original English name was not good enough for them. So in France it is called Fast & Furious 7 but I believe it is called Furious Seven in the US. Typical French way of doing things I am afraid. This movie is probably not for everyone.

Once they'd put paid to some criminal antics that ended up with Fed "Shaw" (Luke Evans) in a coma, the gang had returned home to get on with their lives - without reckoning on the vengeful and meticulous fury of his British special forces expert big brother (Jason Statham).
